events.text:
I found a 54-move solution, and the checker confirms it wins.

The trader needs a bridge from its island down to the door island, over the water at (17,16). The only way is to push the boulder at (16,12) down column 17 into that water. To do that, the trader has to stand at (17,11), above the boulder. It can only get there by being teleported through the mirror, so the plan moves the trader back and forth between the islands:

1. **To the mirror island:** walk to (17,12) (`URU`). Press X and the mirror at (21,12) sends the trader to (21,16).
2. **Build a landing spot:** push the second boulder from (22,14) down column 21 until it sinks at (21,17), which makes that cell floor. Then push the mirror down to (21,13).
3. **Back to the trader's island:** stand on (21,17) and press X, which lands the trader at (17,13).
4. **Line up the bridge boulder:** walk round and push the boulder from (16,12) east to (17,12). Then step to (17,13) and press X to go back to (21,17).
5. **Set the last jump:** push the mirror up to (21,11) and stand on (21,15). Press X and the trader lands at (17,11), right above the boulder.
6. **Finish:** press D eight times. The first four pushes sink the boulder at (17,16) to make the bridge. The trader then walks down to the door at (17,19).
